title: rs57494551 increases CXCR5 expression and IgM(+) CXCR5(+) B-cell infiltration in the portal area of primary biliary cholangitis.
authors: Hitomi, Yuki; Aiba, Yoshihiro; Ueno, Kazuko; Takahashi, Haruka; Kono, Michihiro; Sugi, Kazuhiro; Teraoka, Yuji; Takaki, Shintaro; Naganuma, Atsushi; Kojima, Motoyuki; Nishida, Nao; Kawai, Yosuke; Kawashima, Minae; Khor, Seik-Soon; Yasunami, Michio; Komori, Atsumasa; Shimoda, Shinji; Ishigaki, Kazuyoshi; Nagasaki, Masao; Tokunaga, Katsushi; Nakamura, Minoru
one_liner_zh: 该文通过GWAS后分析、机器学习转录因子预测和Prime Editor技术，研究rs57494551变异调控CXCR5表达及B细胞浸润，涉及转录因子TEAD3与DNA结合，但核心是疾病机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法上机器学习仅用于预测，缺乏AI/物理模拟的深度建模。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) is a chronic, progressive, cholestatic liver disease caused by autoimmune reactions. A previous international meta-analysis of a genome-wide association study (GWAS) reported a robust association of the human chr.11q23.3 locus including C-X-C motif chemokine receptor 5 (CXCR5) with susceptibility to PBC. However, the molecular mechanism by which CXCR5 confers disease susceptibility in PBC remains unclear. METHODS: Cutting-edge post-GWAS analyses were conducted using in silico and in vitro functional approaches, including multi-omics analysis, machine-learning-based transcription factor prediction, and prime editor as a genome-editing technology. Expression data for CXCR5 and correlated genes were obtained by RNA-seq and immunohistochemistry analyses. RESULTS: Among the variants around CXCR5, rs57494551 was identified as a disease-causal variant for PBC. rs57494551 regulates endogenous CXCR5 expression in B-cells through binding to the transcription repressor TEA domain transcription factor 3 (TEAD3). CXCR5 expression was correlated with disease activity, as identified by hierarchical clustering of mRNA expression patterns, and portal inflammation markers, such as serum IgM, Aspartate Transferase (AST), and Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi). The number of IgM(+) CXCR5(+) B-cells was increased in the portal area of PBC with high-disease activity. CONCLUSIONS: Immune dysregulation and portal inflammation are affected by increased expression of CXCR5 on IgM(+) B-cells in PBC patients who have the risk allele of rs57494551, indicating that CXCR5 is a potential therapeutic target for PBC. HIGHLIGHTS: Among hundreds of genetic variants in CXCR5, rs57494551 was identified as a disease-causal variant using cutting-edge post-GWAS in silico and in vitro analyses, including multi-omics analysis, machine learning-based prediction, and the genome-editing technology "Prime Editor." The disease risk allele of rs57494551 increases endogenous CXCR5 expression in B-cells by releasing the binding of the transcriptional repressor TEAD3. RNA-seq and immunohistochemistry analyses revealed that CXCR5 expression is correlated with disease activity and portal inflammation markers. Furthermore, the number of IgM+ CXCR5+ B-cells was increased in the portal area of PBC with high disease activity. As well as PBC, the signifi cant associations between CXCR5 and susceptibility to various autoimmune diseases, including rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, inflammatory bowel disease, multiple sclerosis, systemic sclerosis, celiac disease, and Sjogren's syndrome, could be explained by the effect of rs57494551.
abstract_zh: 背景：原发性胆汁性胆管炎（PBC）是一种由自身免疫反应引起的慢性、进行性、胆汁淤积性肝病。此前一项国际全基因组关联研究（GWAS）荟萃分析报告，人类染色体11q23.3位点（包括C-X-C基序趋化因子受体5（CXCR5））与PBC易感性存在强关联。然而，CXCR5赋予PBC疾病易感性的分子机制仍不清楚。方法：采用计算机模拟和体外功能方法进行了前沿的GWAS后分析，包括多组学分析、基于机器学习的转录因子预测，以及作为基因组编辑技术的prime editor。通过RNA-seq和免疫组织化学分析获得CXCR5及其相关基因的表达数据。结果：在CXCR5周围的变异中，rs57494551被确定为PBC的致病性变异。rs57494551通过与转录抑制因子TEA结构域转录因子3（TEAD3）结合，调控B细胞中内源性CXCR5的表达。CXCR5表达与疾病活动性相关，这通过mRNA表达模式的分层聚类识别，并与门静脉炎症标志物（如血清IgM、天冬氨酸转移酶（AST）和Mac-2结合蛋白糖基化异构体（M2BPGi））相关。在高疾病活动性的PBC门静脉区域，IgM(+) CXCR5(+) B细胞数量增加。结论：在携带rs57494551风险等位基因的PBC患者中，IgM(+) B细胞上CXCR5表达增加影响免疫失调和门静脉炎症，表明CXCR5是PBC的潜在治疗靶点。亮点：在CXCR5中数百个遗传变异中，通过前沿的GWAS后计算机模拟和体外分析（包括多组学分析、基于机器学习的预测和基因组编辑技术“Prime Editor”），rs57494551被确定为致病性变异。rs57494551的疾病风险等位基因通过释放转录抑制因子TEAD3的结合，增加B细胞中内源性CXCR5的表达。RNA-seq和免疫组织化学分析揭示，CXCR5表达与疾病活动性和门静脉炎症标志物相关。此外，在高疾病活动性的PBC门静脉区域，IgM+ CXCR5+ B细胞数量增加。除PBC外，CXCR5与多种自身免疫疾病（包括类风湿关节炎、系统性红斑狼疮、炎症性肠病、多发性硬化症、系统性硬化症、乳糜泻和干燥综合征）易感性之间的显著关联，也可通过rs57494551的效应来解释。
